newsitem.title: USA: Union Pacific finalizes stk payout terms.
newsitem.headline: Union Pacific finalizes stk payout terms.

text.p: Union Pacific Corp on Monday finalized the exact proration on a previously announced special stock dividend.
Union Pacific said its shareholders would receive 0.846946 of a share of Union Pacific Resources Group common stock for each Union Pacific common share held.

Union Pacific said earlier a special stock dividend of the remaining common shares of Union Pacific Resources was payable on October 15 to shareholders of record on September 26. This included holders of Union Pacific shares issued in the Southern Pacific Rail Corp, merger, it said in a statement.
The special dividend is not itself directly related to the merger.
